items.description: Fix naming incongruencies between internal names/IDs/comments/variables and the user-facing tool names in this repo (all tool HTML files, index.html, assets/). The "Congruence Wheel" tool is internally named/referenced as "Pizza Slices" (or lowercase variants) in localStorage keys, comments, or titles - audit and align internal naming to the public name "Congruence Wheel" (flag if a localStorage key rename is a compatibility break rather than silently doing it). The "Venn Diagram" tool must be called "Venn Diagram" everywhere, never "Prime Venn Diagram" - fix every occurrence (titles, headers, index.html card, page <title>, comments, nav). Also search for and fix any other similar name drift across all tools.

In the "Venn Diagram" tool, extend the palette of primes which currently stops at 37 by adding the next 14 primes (41, 43, 47, 53, 59, 61, 67, 71, 73, 79, 83, 89, 97, 101), updating any UI/legend/selection logic that depends on the palette length.

In the Diffie-Hellman Key Exchange tool, when public exponents/values are exchanged, the animation shows them traveling along the wire between Alice and Bob but does not show them traveling to Eve - they just appear directly in Eve's notebook. Fix the animation so the user sees the public values visually travel to Eve (e.g. a packet animating from the Alice-Bob wire to Eve's notebook) before appearing recorded there, consistent with the Alice/Bob animation style.
